task.title: Correct the stale 100 ms warm api-update target in the root README
task.description:
README.md:1300 still states the warm api-update scenario's inclusive p95 target is 100 ms. The budget has been 150 ms since 2026-08-08: warmUpdateTarget in internal/perf/scenarios.go (~:1027-1031) sets 150 ms, and docs/performance/README.md carries the approval section 'api-update target: 150 ms (approved 2026-08-08)'. The copy of this stale figure in docs/performance/README.md:33 was re-authored and corrected during PR #74's review round; the root README line is the last remaining instance (verified untouched on main at that PR's merge).

Acceptance: README.md's hot-loop passage states 150 ms; a grep for '100 ms' near api-update mentions across README.md and docs/performance/README.md finds only historical/evidence-table uses (docs/performance/README.md:192, :344, :390 are records of the superseded budget and stay as-is).
